lines.en: I walk the deep, and no sand rises.
My two hands each find their own way.
The water parts for me, then closes.

lines.zh: 每步都踩在沉船的骨架上。
lines.en: Each step lands on a sunken ship's ribs.
I move slowly; the current does the rest.

lines.zh: 左手摸到礁石，右手摸到你。
lines.en: One hand finds the reef, the other finds you.
Underwater there are no roads, only depth.
I drag the weight of a whole sea.

lines.zh: 船帆的碎片还挂在我背上。
lines.en: Rags of sail still hang from my back.
I do not breathe while I walk.
Twelve blocks down is where I belong.
Listen; the water counts my steps.
I rest at the bottom without moving.

lines.zh: 两只手在商量怎么分你。
lines.en: My two hands discuss how to divide you.
A whirlpool begins turning at my feet.
Wood soaked long enough turns hard.
I wait for the water to deepen.
My mouth opens, and the water flows through.

lines.zh: 沉船的木板是我的盔甲。
lines.en: Planks from wrecks are my armor.
The deep has no light, which suits me.
I count the bubbles drifting upward.
Do not hurry; the sea will deliver you.

lines.zh: 岸上的人总以为水很浅。
lines.en: People ashore always think the water is shallow.
Bring your face near the water, closer.
Your reflection sits inside my front mouth.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是怕水。
lines.en: I know that look; it fears the water.
Do not blink; the water will blink for you.
While you stare, my hands are moving.
Your feet are still on dry ground.
I see you the way I see driftwood.
Eye to eye, and water to water.
Look up so I can remember your face.
Your sword is blunt underwater.
Fifteen layers of hide; you cannot cut through.
It stings, but the water seals the wound.
You struck the sail scraps on my back.
That knocked me down half a block.

lines.zh: 两只手都缩回来护住前口。
lines.en: Both hands pull back to guard my mouth.
My blood spreads through the water like mist.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，可惜水太深。
lines.en: You hit hard, but the water is deep.
A broken hide does not mean you won.

lines.zh: 我退了，是因为漩涡还没站稳。
lines.en: I backed off; my whirlpool was not set.

lines.zh: 拿食物下水？先淹了再说。
lines.en: Food in the water? Drowning comes first.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我吃会喘的。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I eat what breathes.
Throw that rotten flesh into the deep.
Your hand smells better than the food.
The food sank; I cannot be bothered.
You are feeding the sea, not me.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，水会告诉我。
lines.en: When I am hungry, the water tells me.

lines.zh: 两根手指就够了，别整块。
lines.en: Two fingers are enough; no whole handful.
Bring fish, not wheat.
Put it away; I want something alive.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的胸甲，像撞礁。
lines.en: You hit my chest plate like a reef.
Both hands caught you at once.
The water reaches exactly to your chin.
Do not push; a whirlpool is behind me.
You brushed the sail scraps on my back.
Pressing close suits my mouth.
My hide is thicker than a hull.
That bump muddied the water.
Your retreat trails a string of bubbles.
Touch me again and I hold you under.
The deep has no use for pairs.
Breeding? My eggs sink into the mud.
A mate would end up in my front mouth.

lines.zh: 水已经够冷，别再添一个。
lines.en: The water is cold enough without another.

lines.zh: 同类相遇只会争一片海。
lines.en: Two of my kind only fight over one sea.

lines.zh: 我不需要谁来继承漩涡。
lines.en: No one needs to inherit my whirlpool.

lines.zh: 交配在我的世界里很陌生。
lines.en: Mating is a strange idea in my world.
Asking that — eager to get in the water?
My offspring swim off on their own.
Go away; the sea is loud in season.
I want that plank; it is armor.
The iron you dropped has sunk.
I only pick up what floats.

lines.zh: 那根桅杆能加厚我的背。
lines.en: That mast can thicken my back.
I collect wreck cargo piece by piece.
Do not fish it out; that wood is mine.
One hand takes each piece.
I found a fine stretch of sailcloth.
Splintered wood beats gold on the seabed.
Let go; I saw it first.
You stepped into the water; excellent.

lines.zh: 左手看见你，右手也看见了。
lines.en: My left hand sees you; my right does too.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在水里传得远。
lines.en: Your heartbeat carries far underwater.
Deep enough; let us begin.
I will put you into my front mouth.
You waited too long on the shore.
The ripples on the surface gave you away.
I do not chase; I wait for you to sink.
My two hands have already split the work.
You swim well, but not fast enough.

lines.zh: 漩涡会把你的力气卷走。
lines.en: The whirlpool will unwind your strength.
That plank will not shield you.

lines.zh: 我把你算进了今天的潮。
lines.en: I counted you into today's tide.

lines.zh: 抓住你之前，先记住你的形状。
lines.en: Before I grab you, I memorize your shape.
Both hands are turned toward you.

lines.zh: 两只手一左一右围过来。
lines.en: My hands close in from left and right.
You rise, and I rise with you.

lines.zh: 别往浅处游，那里没意思。
lines.en: Do not swim shallow; there is nothing there.
Three blocks left before you run out of air.

lines.zh: 我数你的气泡，越数越少。
lines.en: I count your bubbles, and they thin out.
If the left hand lags, the right covers.

lines.zh: 水开始转，你感觉到了吗？
lines.en: The water is turning; do you feel it?
I press the surface down; you cannot rise.
You are grabbing in the wrong direction.
Back up more and you hit my chest plate.
The whirlpool tightens like a pair of hands.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路也泡软了。
lines.en: I have soaked your escape route soft.
Closer now; your foot is in my palm.
There is a place already waiting in my mouth.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被我一脚踹起来。
lines.en: My step kicks the bottom mud up.

lines.zh: 你往前走，我给你让了条道。
lines.en: Go ahead. I have opened a lane for you.

lines.zh: 我的胸甲贴着水，你就跑不快。
lines.en: My chest plate drags the water. You will not be fast.

lines.zh: 你头顶还剩一小片空气。
lines.en: You have one small patch of air left above you.
Got you; into the mouth you go.
Fifteen points, and the water helps.
The harder you struggle, the faster you sink.
My front mouth closes, and the light is gone.
This blow breaks your stroke.
You flop in my palm like a fish.
The pressure holds you down for me.
Once is not enough; again.
Your armor slides easily underwater.
I press you into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一掌拍碎了你的浮力。
lines.en: This slap shattered what kept you floating.
You are coughing; that pleases me.
In you go; do not waste air.

lines.zh: 手松开时，你已经不动了。
lines.en: When my hand opens, you have stopped moving.

lines.zh: 我一把把你按住，水替我压。
lines.en: I pin you down and the water holds you.
You cough out bubbles. I count them.

lines.zh: 潮水退得太快，我露了出来。
lines.en: The tide pulled back too fast, and I showed.

lines.zh: 我从前口吐出一口海水。
lines.en: I spat a mouthful of seawater from my front mouth.
Twelve blocks down, I woke.

lines.zh: 沉船的木头先动，我才动。
lines.en: The wreck's wood stirred first; then I did.
The whirlpool began with my breathing.

lines.zh: 两只手先睁开，眼睛后睁开。
lines.en: My hands opened first; my eyes followed.

lines.zh: 海底的泥翻起来，盖住我。
lines.en: Seabed mud rolled up and covered me.
These waters have an owner now.
I smell fire from the shore.
The wind rattled the sail scraps.

lines.zh: 我从深处往上浮了一层。
lines.en: I rose one layer up from the deep.
A new sea, and the same old hunger.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，烧不到我。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface, not on me.

lines.zh: 我从深处摔下，泥接住了。
lines.en: I fell through the deep, and the mud caught me.

lines.zh: 我本来就住水里，怎么淹？
lines.en: I live here; how would I drown?
The blast punched a hole in the water.

lines.zh: 箭在水里走三步就软了。
lines.en: The arrow goes soft three blocks in.

lines.zh: 法术在水下散成一圈光。
lines.en: The spell scatters into a ring of light.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，漩涡也转得慢。
lines.en: When I starve, even my whirlpool slows.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，整片海发白。
lines.en: Lightning entered the sea, and it went white.
There is no water here; I dislike it.
